cohort: The participants were preterm piglets (98/115d gestation, ~28wk gestation infant equivalent) and term piglets.
finding: At 30 minutes after birth, blood volume was significantly lower in preterm piglets compared to term piglets, and both groups experienced substantial reductions in blood volume after birth, with preterm piglets consistently having lower blood volumes than term piglets by 5-9 hours post-birth.
gest_age: Preterm piglets (98/115d gestation, ~28wk gestation infant equivalent) and term piglets.
